about: Hand-kept: turns questlines_raw.json (one line per mod, plus two vanilla buckets) into the quest lines a player would pick from. Each line has a home category (one of the six in 'categories', or the 'work' shelf) and may sit in others too ('also'). scripts/gamedata/questlines.py reads this with quests_raw.json and questlines_raw.json, checks that every raw line and every bucket quest lands somewhere, and writes questlines_report.md. Facts the records don't hold (how a line starts, its gate, its level, its length) come from the field guide's lorerim/world/quests-and-lands.md; 'checked' says where each came from: files (read from the winning records in Dave's install), mod page, or players. A line with no fact has nothing checked yet. 'mainQuestAt' names the main-quest quest (EDID) that must be finished for a line that needs the main quest; a line with 'main-quest' in 'after' and no 'mainQuestAt' needs some of it, how far not yet checked.

main.name: Main stories
main.subtitle: The game's three long stories: the main quest, Dawnguard and Dragonborn
main.more: Each runs for many hours. In LoreRim, Dawnguard waits for level 30, and Miraak's cultists come at 25 once you've finished The Way of the Voice.

guilds.name: Guilds and factions
guilds.subtitle: Join a guild or a side and work your way up
guilds.more: The Companions, the College, the Thieves Guild, the Dark Brotherhood, the Bards College and the Civil War, plus orders that mods add, like the Vigilants of Stendarr.

daedric.name: Daedric Princes
daedric.subtitle: Quests for the Daedric Princes, most ending in an artifact
daedric.more: LoreRim holds almost all of them back until level 20, and Hircine until 25. Lines that mods add, like Saints and Seducers, are here too.

lands.name: New lands
lands.subtitle: Quests that take you to places outside Skyrim
lands.more: Solstheim, Wyrmstooth, Hammerfell, Morrowind's border, realms of the dead and more. Most are made for level 20 and up.

side.name: Side stories
side.subtitle: Shorter quests in towns, ruins and on the road
side.more: The longest list: the base game's side quests and the ones mods add. Most take an hour or two.

followers.name: Followers
followers.subtitle: Quests that come from your followers
followers.more: Bring them along and their quests come to you. Serana's also belongs to Dawnguard.

work.name: Jobs and errands
work.subtitle: Notice boards, bounties and favours for townsfolk
work.more: Missives boards in every hold, bounties from the jarls, and odd jobs for the people of each town. They come back, so pick one up whenever you like.

lines.name: The Dragonborn
lines.start: Pick The Dragonborn at the dragon statue in the Helgen inn. The main quest starts with the cart ride into Helgen.
lines.gate: None. After Before the Storm, Balgruuf no longer walks you to Farengar: the Dragonstone task waits until you ask Farengar about the dragons.

lines.name: Dawnguard
lines.start: Durak comes to recruit you, or walk into Dayspring Canyon, south-east of Riften. Guards' rumours about the Dawnguard also need Laid to Rest done in Morthal.
lines.gate: Level 30 for Durak and the rumours.

lines.name: Dragonborn
lines.start: Miraak's cultists find you once you're level 25 and past The Way of the Voice. You can sail to Raven Rock from Windhelm's docks earlier.
lines.gate: Level 25 and The Way of the Voice, for the cultists.

lines.name: The Companions
lines.start: Talk to Kodlak Whitemane in Jorrvaskr, Whiterun. Or take the Companions start.
lines.gate: None. Jobs open the next part: 3 before Proving Honor, 5 more before The Silver Hand, 4 more before Blood's Honor (12 in all).

lines.name: The College of Winterhold
lines.start: Pass Faralda's test at the College bridge in Winterhold: cast one of the spells she asks for. After The Way of the Voice a Shout also gets you in. Or take the College start.

lines.name: The Thieves Guild
lines.start: Brynjolf comes up to you in Riften's market, between 8 in the morning and 8 at night.

lines.name: The Dark Brotherhood
lines: ACDB - Additional Contracts for the Dark Brotherhood
lines.start: Aventus Aretino in Windhelm (Innocence Lost). Kill Grelod, sleep, and Astrid finds you. Or take the Dark Brotherhood start.

lines.name: The Civil War
lines: After the Civil War - Siege Damage Repairs
lines.start: Join the Legion with Legate Rikke at Castle Dour, Solitude, or the Stormcloaks with Galmar Stone-Fist in Windhelm.

lines.name: Vigilant
lines.start: Altano and Orlando wait in the Windpeak Inn, Dawnstar.
lines.level: 30–40 and up for Acts II to IV
lines.note: Four acts, ending in Coldharbour. Most of the Coldharbour quests pay no quest XP: they're typed Misc.

lines.name: Meridia's Order
lines.start: After The Break of Dawn, a paladin greets you in a city. Or go to the Sanctum near Rimerock Burrow, west of Solitude.
lines.gate: The Break of Dawn, which waits for level 20.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling
lines.note: The Man in Black is a second way through, with Rudin Filaro at the Temple of Mara.

lines.name: Pieces of the Past
lines: Mehrunes Dagon's Shrine Unlocked - Pieces of the Past Quest Alternative - Voiced
lines.note: Reforging the Past lets you reforge the Razor without Dagon.

lines.name: The Break of Dawn
lines.gate: Level 20, and not as a vampire.

lines.name: Saints and Seducers
lines: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
lines.start: Carries on Sheogorath's story after The Mind of Madness, in the Shivering Isles.
lines.gate: Level 20, after The Mind of Madness.

lines.name: The Taste of Death
lines: The Taste of Death - Quest Addon

lines.name: The Whispering Door
lines: Mephala's Curse - Whispering Door Quest Addon

lines.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare
lines: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare - New Daedric Prince Quest
lines.start: Ralforn at Green-Tip Cabin, north-east of Ivarstead.

lines.name: Wyrmstooth
lines.start: An Imperial courier, Theodyn Bienne, finds you and sends you to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
lines.gate: Level 20, Rise in the East done, and the main quest through The Way of the Voice.

lines.name: Journey to Baan Malur
lines: Journey to Baan Malur and Morrowind
lines.start: Take the paid ferry from Raven Rock, or walk east of Windhelm through the Dwemer ruin Kalbthurz.
lines.level: Morrowind's creatures: treat it as 25 and up

lines.name: Siege at Icemoth
lines.where: Islands north of Skyrim, near High Rock
lines.start: Read the dead mercenary's waterlogged journal at the Old Wooden Jetty, on the north-west beach west of Northwatch Keep.

lines.name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
lines: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal - 10th anniversary
Betalille's Hammerfell Quests Bundle - The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
lines.start: Starts once you've finished the Thieves Guild (Under New Management).

lines.name: The Forgotten City
lines.start: A courier brings you a letter.

lines.name: Gravewind
lines.where: A realm of the dead, entered from Falkreath
lines.start: LoreRim locks the abandoned homestead north-west of Roadside Ruins, Falkreath. The Cemetery Homestead Key is on Vighar, the vampire in Bloodlet Throne: Dengeir of Stuhn in Falkreath sends you after him (Dark Ancestor). Once inside, you're trapped.
lines.gate: The Cemetery Homestead Key, from Vighar in Bloodlet Throne.
lines.note: LoreRim's own patch (LoreRim Gravewind Start Tweak.esp) adds the lock and the key; the mod page's "walk in" is out of date.

lines.name: Miasma
lines.start: Haj-Xul, in the Retching Netch, Raven Rock.

lines.name: The Book of Love
lines: The Book of Love - Fastred's Awakening

lines.name: Seeking A Cure

lines.name: A Forgotten Blade
lines: Redeeming Fultheim - A Blades Quest Addon

lines.name: Undeath
lines.where: The Reach, then all over Skyrim
lines.start: A rumour that a Vigil of Stendarr caravan was attacked in the Reach, or find the ambush yourself. A note in the Markarth inn also points you there.
lines.note: You can end it as a lich.

lines.name: Granite Hill
lines.start: A courier brings a note after you've killed the dragon at the Western Watchtower.
lines.level: The dungeon under the shop holds a level 50 boss and two at 34

lines.name: Legends of Aetherium
lines: Legends of Aetherium - New Dungeon - Quest - Armour - Weapons
lines.start: A hiring notice in the Bee and Barb, the Frozen Hearth, Candlehearth Hall or the Bannered Mare. Or walk to the dig near Crystaldrift Cave.

lines.name: The Tools of Kagrenac
lines.start: A courier letter a couple of days after Arniel's Endeavor gives you Keening.

lines.name: Deluge of Deceit
lines.start: Frissa Black-Briar, at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften.
lines.level: Early levels, by the author: 3 to 15

lines.name: Heart of the Reach
lines: Heart of the Reach - New Quest - Dungeon - Weapons - 3 Creature Variants - Ring - Spell
lines.start: Gwilym, in the Silver-Blood Inn, Markarth.

lines.name: The Welkynar Knight
lines.start: A courier note asks you to a secret meeting at the Bannered Mare.

lines.name: Relics of the Crusader
lines.note: Knight of the North reworks it: the relics are hidden with devoted servants of the Divines. Players report the one at Stendarr's Beacon is a Thalmor ambush.

lines.name: Belethor's Sister
lines.start: Talk to Belethor in Whiterun.
lines.gate: Level 20, and the Soul Cairn open (Dawnguard's Chasing Echoes).

lines.name: Revealing Rune
lines.start: Ask Rune about his name.
lines.gate: A member of the Thieves Guild.

lines: More to do in the Soul Cairn
lines.start: Inside the Soul Cairn, during Dawnguard's Chasing Echoes.

lines.name: Missives
lines.start: Read a notice board in any of the nine hold capitals, and on Solstheim, Wyrmstooth and in Hammerfell. The boards refresh every three days.
lines.level: Delivery and gathering jobs are the safest money at level 1
lines.note: LoreRim pays these as Side quests.

lines.name: Bounties and favours for the jarls
lines.start: Ask a jarl or their steward for work.
lines.gate: Warlock and draugr bounties at level 15, giants and spriggans 20, hagravens and Falmer 25, vampires and dragons 30. Jarls' favours: the vampire at 10, hagravens at 20, the giant at 22.

notInRecords.name: Demon of Dream
notInRecords.why: Installed (folder Demon of Dream). Field guide: three Vaermina dream-dungeons; take the Idol of Vaermina in Cragwallow Slope, east of Windhelm, and read the note; 15 and up, 2–3 hours (mod page).

notInRecords.name: Finding Velehk Sain
notInRecords.why: Installed (Finding_VelehkSain.esp). Field guide: four missing College apprentices and a dremora pirate; starts at the College, a black gauntlet in the Midden; about an hour (mod page).

notInRecords.name: Unmasking Sybille
notInRecords.why: Not found under that name in the plugin list. Field guide: investigate Solitude's vampire court wizard; Melaran, Odar, or evidence in Solitude; 30 minutes (mod page).

notInRecords.name: Ascend - Hidden Peaks of Skyrim
notInRecords.why: Installed. Exploration with no journal: ten secret mountain routes, found by the winds that mark them (mod page).

notInRecords.name: Dragon's Teeth Prison
notInRecords.why: Field guide: a dungeon west of Falkreath where Vigilants investigate a Hircine coven; walk in; 20 and up (players). No quest record kept.
